cuts.line: There's no reason that should have kicked like that, Tiger.
They did not consider camera tripod placements when designing this course, Tiger.
End with a bogey on the front nine.
I hate to do a call-out like this because dude's been through enough, but I think Tiger really threw in the towel on the design of this hole.
Honestly, props to Tiger for designing an entire mini golf course without a single windmill.
I'd be really curious to know what Tiger scored on this. I wonder if he's ever played it.
